Task Guide: Task: 
Task: Bulk Modulus of Copper
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of copper by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for copper. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

- units: metal
- pbc: true
- minimiser: conjugate gradient
- energy_tolerance: 1e-10
- force_tolerance: 1e-10
- maximum_iterations: 100000.0
- maximum_evaluations: 100000.0
- materials_project_id: mp-30
- atom_style: atomic
- deformation_step_size: 1e-06
- total_deformation: -1 * (deformation_step_size * lattice parameter)

Thought: The `EAM` directory contains a potential file named `Cu_Zhou04.eam.alloy`, which is likely the appropriate EAM potential for copper. I will now proceed to write a LAMMPS input script that uses this potential, applies small finite deformations, and calculates the elastic stiffness tensor. This script will be saved in the specified path.
Action: write_file
Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/react/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/copper_bulk_modulus_trial_3/lammps_input.in", "content": "
# LAMMPS input script for calculating the bulk modulus of copper
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/react/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/copper_bulk_modulus_trial_3/copper_structure.data

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Cu_Zhou04.eam.alloy Cu

# Minimize the structure
min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Apply small finite deformations and calculate stress
variable delta equal 1e-06

# Loop over the six independent strain modes
variable i loop 6
label loop

# Apply deformation
if "${i} == 1" then "displace_atoms all move v_delta 0 0"
if "${i} == 2" then "displace_atoms all move 0 v_delta 0"
if "${i} == 3" then "displace_atoms all move 0 0 v_delta"
if "${i} == 4" then "displace_atoms all move 0 v_delta v_delta"
if "${i} == 5" then "displace_atoms all move v_delta 0 v_delta"
if "${i} == 6" then "displace_atoms all move v_delta v_delta 0"

# Run simulation
run 0

# Output stress
variable stress equal "-pxx -pyy -pzz -pyz -pxz -pxy"
print "${stress}"

next i
jump SELF loop

# End of script
"}
